fact: The Ministry of Habitat and Urban Development, under the World Bank-financed Sustainable Cities and Land Management Project, is selecting candidates on 2 June 2026 to design, supply and install a Land Information System (SIF) in Yaounde and Douala.

The Ministry of Housing and Urban Development's call of 11 September 2026, financed by an IDA credit, seeks a supervisor for a provider building a land information system (SIF) in Yaounde and Douala for the Ministry of State Property, Surveys and Land Tenure.
